title: Publish Cloud Best Config Request
description: Request body for publishing a canonical best config to cloud storage without moving the agent head. Ordinary publish rejects NaN and Infinity, a spec nested deeper than 16 levels, and duplicate object keys after Unicode NFC normalization before persistence. Validation returns 400 BEST_CONFIG_VALIDATION_ERROR. The NFC collision message names no key, but other validation messages can include field paths. The frozen legacy spec_hash rule retains last-wins handling so stored specs can still be verified and rolled back.

environment.description: Optional explicit deployment environment. If provided it must match spec.environment.
